title: MaskPlan
description: The complete set of covers to draw now. Veil contract v1.0. Units: positions and sizes are integer screen pixels with the origin at the top-left of the display in its current orientation (x grows right, y grows down); times are integer milliseconds on one monotonic clock (Android SystemClock.uptimeMillis; replays use a virtual clock in the same unit); fingerprints are L2-normalised vectors stored as float16.

screenWidth.description: Screen width the rects refer to.

screenHeight.description: Screen height the rects refer to.

basedOnFrameId.description: Frame the plan was computed from.

reason.description: Why a new plan was made.
